title: Goose Announces Dates For 13th Annual Goosemas Holiday Shows
summary: This year's holiday celebration will take place on Dec. 11-12 at the historic Jim Whelan Boardwalk Hall in Atlantic City, N.J.
contentText:
Goose announced the dates for their 13th annual Goosemas holiday shows on Monday morning (July 20). The gigs are set for Dec. 11-12 at the historic Jim Whelan Boardwalk Hall in Atlantic City, N.J., with presale sign-ups available now here .

Goose dropped their sixth studio album, Big Modern! , last month on their own No Coincidence Records label and have been on the road on their annual summer tour since the beginning of June, including two nights at New York’s Madison Square Garden and a surprise, sold-out performance at Central Park’s SummerStage on June 21. The band will be back on the road beginning on Aug. 13 with a show at the Cal Coast Credit Union Amphitheater in San Diego, bringing along some special guests on the run, including Greensky Bluegrass and Buffalo Traffic Jam.

They will play through the Christmas dates and then head down to Mexico from January 20-23 for two sets at Dave Matthews and Tim Reynolds’ 10 Years on the Beach festival at Riviera Maya alongside Sierra Ferrell and Stephen Wilson Jr at the Moon Palace.
